FIXALL 6 WEBSITES / SPEED05

A 62 MB front door. 24-second phone loads.

MAC's desktop homepage loads a single 61.8 MB video file. In mobile lab tests, Casa Lola took 24.5 seconds and Cafeteria took 15.8 seconds to show main content.

Vessel: Compress video and images so menus and booking open fast on phones.
Speed test breakdown ›
FIXPAID ADS & SEARCH06

Promoters run the ads. Google gets 2025 dates.

Google's ad library shows no active venue ads since February, and a third-party promoter is running the only visible MIX ad on Meta. Meanwhile, site code still feeds Google 2025 events.

Vessel: Run clean venue campaigns, retarget visitors across every brand, and fix search schema.
Google Ads library ›
